firstPlayerRule: Whoever holds the 2 of clubs after the pass leads first. In a three-player game, the page says the 3 of clubs is led instead.
clarifications: For three players the 2 of diamonds is removed; for five players the 2 of clubs is removed.
interpretation: With the 2 of clubs removed in a five-player game, this site reads the rule as the holder of the lowest remaining club leading.

sources.title: Hearts: How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Hearts page in a browser. "The Play": "The player holding the 2 of clubs after the pass makes the opening lead. If the 2 has been removed for the three handed game, then the 3 of clubs is led." "The Deal" says the 2 of diamonds is removed for three players and the 2 of clubs for five players.
uncertainty: The page’s three-player removal (2 of diamonds) and lead instruction (3 of clubs) do not match exactly; the lead instruction is quoted as written.
The five-player opening lead is not stated.
